messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: Weird ggvis behavior for layer_images()
parts:
Hi all,

This is not a serious bug - maybe more of a "weird ggvis trick".

It seems that, in transition, the url property is interpolated as a string, if the two url strings at either end are "close enough". This causes weirdness.

I put an example here:

https://ijlyttle.shinyapps.io/ggvis_layer_image/

Description displayed at bottom of app.

Uses ggvis 3.0.1.

Thanks,

Ian
